rationale: Prevent approved QUALIFYING direct documented facts from being promoted automatically into customer MEANING. For CUSTOMER plain-language rendering, PRIMARY facts remain direct answers while QUALIFYING canonical mechanics remain CONDITION/audit content unless a separate governed customer qualification or next-step semantic explicitly authorizes customer-facing communication. The governed PED education asset is also simplified at its reviewed education-data layer without changing formal source evidence or product mechanics.
supersession_impact: No authoritative evidence, finding, publication, condition, or canonical mechanic is deleted or rewritten. The change affects customer presentation relevance only; qualifying facts remain represented for explanation fidelity and response audit.
authority_impact: No product, eligibility, coverage, recommendation, claim-approval, or payment authority is broadened. Customer education wording remains governed education and product-specific conclusions continue to come only from authoritative publication.
